risk_note: RV2 by path (app.module.ts). The search fallback (TRADE-20) took the channel the use case selected from the whitelist but served the generic material feed under its name; it now reads that channel through union's createUnionChannelRanking (B1-22p): page 1, the channel's order, the first limit items (BR-TEXT-17 联盟物料频道). A channel removed at fetch time gives nothing with an alert; an adapter without the channel method degrades to no fallback with an alert and the search still succeeds. search.ts is unchanged. channels and logger are optional options because frozen kits call createUnionSearchUpstream without them; both production callers pass the logger (checked by the review, no rule test pins it). The whitelist is empty today, so this path does not run yet; real adapters still need CAP-*-10. No money moves. verify:fast exit 0 (api 3674, spec-tests 20530). Codex was unavailable until 11-02, so the rule tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
